concept.title: ALC269 Audio Refactor - King Kong Offset vs 60dB Hack
concept.tags: linux, kernel, audio, alc269, realtek, sound, amplifier, debian, patch
concept.description: Lessons learned from rewriting the Realtek ALC269 sound driver for the Sony VAIO SVE14A3AJ. The legacy approach used a buggy +60 dB hardcoded hack which caused audio distortion. The new approach surgically removes the hardcoded hack and replaces it with a clean firmware-level EAPD pin control.
